name: createTimeSpan
description: Creates a timespan object that defines a time period.
syntax: createTimeSpan( number days, number hours, number minutes, number seconds, [number milliseconds] )

params.name: days
params.description: number of days in time period

params.name: hours
params.description: number of hours in time period

params.name: minutes
params.description: number of minutes in time period

params.name: seconds
params.description: number of seconds in time period

params.name: milliseconds
params.description: number of milliseconds in time period
